title: Transparently
description: Txt which adds transparent texture to items and particles
body:
**This is a silly texture pack which adds little transparent textures for items instead of make it smaller.**

***Which things are transparent ? :***

**All Swords, Bow (every pulling animation makes it more transparent), Totem of Undying, Enchanted Golden Apple, Golden Apple, Inventory and Totem of undying particles.**
